purpose: Freeze the analysis comparison settings before observing full-universe model outputs. This is a project execution record, not an external preregistration.
basis: Fixed current constituents and current sectors; historical membership not reconstructed

fixed_settings.ridge_objective: Unnormalized residual sum of squares plus alpha times coefficient norm; effective shrinkage depends on training sample size
fixed_settings.portfolio: Long top tercile 100 percent, short bottom tercile 100 percent

permitted_repairs: Correct source identity, filing extraction, dates, missingness and documented implementation bugs. Record material changes; do not choose hyperparameters from full-universe returns.
evaluation_note: The full sample overlaps the pilot and expands its cross section. It is not an independent holdout replication.
